notes: One-shot replacement-adjacent client-level DP. Each client locally fits the bounded three-ratio model. Log parameters are mapped with public estimator bounds to [-1,1]^3 and clipped at sqrt(3). Each oracle family of n=10 releases one noisy mean. Replacement sensitivity is 2*sqrt(3)/n. Noise uses the analytic Gaussian calibration for each (epsilon,delta), delta=1e-5. Clipping the noisy normalized mean back to [-1,1]^3 is DP-preserving post-processing. Ten independent privacy draws are evaluated on each of ten fresh fleets. Secure summation is assumed from 8B; cryptographic overhead is not simulated. Utility gate is descriptive: identify privacy levels with <=10% tracking increase versus the epsilon=infinity mean, amplitude feasibility, and frozen rho below one.
